notes.title: New Behind-the-Scenes Video
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone! It has almost been a year since the original release of Serafina's Saga: Awakened, and it's now on a big sale for the Steam Visual Novel Fest Event!

To celebrate, I made a special behind-the-scenes video in which you can hear directly from me and some members of the cast. I talk about my original inspirations for Serafina's Saga, why I remade it, and why I believe the story has increased relevance in today's troubled times. 

[previewyoutube=Vlp5nSZuF-A;full][/previewyoutube]

This is a great time to grab the game while it's on sale, immerse yourself in a romantic adventure, and reflect on what can be done to save a country from a greedy king. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44154257/306ae779c06cc3c6108281508016c88bb7378aea.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Sneak Peek Video Clips
notes.notes:
As the release date for Serafina’s Saga: Awakened approaches (just a little over a month away!), I have a lot of clips from the game to share with you. 

I have several clips available now, and I will keep releasing a video clip from the game every week to give you a preview of exciting moments to come. Follow my Youtube channel at [url=https://youtube.com/@WoodsyStudio]https://youtube.com/@WoodsyStudio[/url] to see them as they release!

In the first clip, see Serafina meet Reuben for the first time. Jezu has a negative viewpoint of Reuben “Jeridar” and isn’t afraid to let his distaste show…

[previewyoutube=MLzAeySb9vg;full][/previewyoutube]

Next, Serafina spies on Xavier and Belatrix speaking in the castle hall. Between each other, they carry many dark secrets...

[previewyoutube=yjosKFOm43w;full][/previewyoutube]

Shortly after Serafina and Valerie first meet, Valerie can tell that Nikolaos and Serafina are hiding something from her...
[previewyoutube=5AqLWvk3V2Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Now catch a glimpse into the sentencing of Arken Jeridar, carried out by King Kallias, Belatrix Grandil, and Kaifu Terrace. Belatrix is passionate about her role, but Kaifu isn't quite sure why they're here...
[previewyoutube=FpK9TIdTLHI;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, tension rises between Jezu and Nikolaos when Jezu suspects him of helping a prisoner escape. As it turns out, these two have never gotten along very well...

[previewyoutube=YichpemPHpw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Serafina's Saga: Awakened Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
As part of the Steam Visual Novel Fest, you can now play the prologue and first Chapter of [i]Serafina's Saga: Awakened! [/i]

Experience the first time Serafina steps out of the jungle, then face the decision of whether to tell her strict guardian, Arken... 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44154257/3bcc83bdc7c2e91d30621ddab04a9f549e216abc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44154257/6e55dfe9cf33b4e1e451e46282bbdfc60db57299.png[/img]

You can also accompany Serafina as she leaves the jungle altogether and embarks on a journey to save Arken, find companionship, and discover herself... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44154257/d4f13d6fd5e3d685c13b5ed26413859377806680.png[/img]

In the meantime, you can also get Woodsy Studio's other games on sale during the Visual Novel Fest. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292520/Crimson_Spires/]Crimson Spires[/url] will be on sale for 50% off for the first time on Steam!
